newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trustpower expects NZ$14 mln yr profit.
newsitem.headline: Trustpower expects NZ$14 mln yr profit.

text.p: TrustPower Ltd said on Tuesday it expected a tax paid profit of not less than NZ$14 million in the year to March.
Chairman Avon Carpenter said it was appropriate to increase the dividend distribution for the period to 80 percent of tax paid profit from the 60 percent that applied last year.
TrustPower earlier recorded a profit of NZ$9.24 million for the half year to September 30 on higher than budgeted sales of $68.9 million.

"Profit is still running considerably ahead of budget and is due to a combination of higher sales revenue and much higher than normal output from the company's three hydro generation schemes at Kaimai, Whaeo and Hinemaimaia," Carpenter said.
"Directors are certainly pleased with the result and a stronger than budgeted end of year result can be expected."
About 60 percent of the company's revenue occurs in the first six months of the financial year and water flows to the generation stations would inevitably be lower in summer.
"Nevertheless the directors believe that the full year result should show a tax paid profit of not less than NZ$14 million," Carpenter said.
